messages:
jasmin: Quick check — final quant recs for optimize-toolkit v0.9 are due EOD. Owners: can you confirm batching/caching compatibility with runtime and call out any regression risk? If you only have partial info, drop what you know. @mike @eva @sam

mike: Ack. I'm blocked on a small kernel mapping mismatch for int4 on T4 pools. Running a quick repro now. ETA ~3h.

eva: From perf bench: default batch_size=8 + prefix cache gives ~15% token-cost savings on long contexts. Haven't validated on int4 yet. Will run in staging and post numbers.

sam: FYI I pushed a small flag to enable conservative KV cache warmup. It's behind feature flag `optkit.kv_warmup=true` in runtime config.

sam: Config snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  /optkit:
    model: redwood/llama-mix-13b-q4
    batching:
      max_batch_tokens: 4096
      min_batch_size: 2
    cache:
      kv_warmup: true
      prefix_ttl: 300
```

leah: CI found a regression in chat smoke tests when cache TTL=0. Repro steps and failing job are in the CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/5821/log — looks like a race between kv warmup and first token. :eyes:

mike: thanks, leah. I'll re-run the repro with prefix_ttl=300 and the warmup flag enabled, see if kernel mismatch still happens.

jasmin: If anyone can't validate today, mark the delivery ticket with 'needs-rollout-hold' on the ownership board. We want no surprises during canary. Also please drop any eval diffs in the evals run: https://e2e.redwood/internal/evals/optkit-v0.9

infra-bot: Canary "canary-optkit-v0.9" started on 3 nodes in us-west-2. Monitor: https://dash.redwood/internal/optkit/canary. No alerts yet.

eva: Quick note — updated the quant recs doc with int4 caveats and a short checklist (bench on T4, fallback path validated): https://docs.redwood/internal/optkit/quant-recs#int4

sam: @jasmin opened PR #3321 with conservative KV warmup + fallback to fp16 if int4 kernel fails. PTAL when you have a sec.

jasmin: Great — thanks everyone. If no blockers reported by 18:00 PT we'll proceed with staged rollout tonight (canary -> 10% -> 50%). Leave :thumbsup: or mark the ticket if you need a hold.
